What a well-built agent actually does.

Real results from agents we built alongside clients, before Archie existed. We’re packaging that work into Archie add-ons now.

Email triage skill

Success: Morning inbox processing dropped from 90 minutes to around 25 minutes.

How: The agent tagged priority messages, drafted responses, and batched low-risk replies for the owner to review and send.

Personal CRM skill

Success: Missed follow-ups fell substantially after automated reminders and draft check-ins.

How: The agent tracked conversations, trigger dates, and next actions across contacts.
